About the club

Where students meet
success stories.

We're a student-run club at Santa Monica College that hosts live interviews and panels with real professionals — so you can learn from people actually doing the work you want to do.

No gatekeeping. No corporate fluff. Just honest conversations about careers, industries, and how to find your path.

What we've been up to

From campus outreach to live speaker sessions — here's a look at what the Career Collective has been doing and what's coming next.

11
May

Sajid Veera — Self-Made Entrepreneur Live Q&A

🕐 1:00 PM – 2:00 PM 📍 BUS 201 — SMC 🎤 Q&A Style

Join us for an exclusive talk with Sajid Veera — a self-made entrepreneur who turned vision into a multimillion dollar business. This is a rare opportunity to hear real insights on what it takes to build, scale, and succeed, and to network with driven peers and industry leaders. Come ready with your questions!

Speaker Event Free Entry

📣 More events coming this semester

Follow us on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Discord to stay updated on all upcoming speakers and events.

Spring 2025

SMC Club Row — Campus Outreach

The Career Collective made its debut at SMC's Club Row — one of the biggest student outreach events on campus. Our team set up a booth to introduce the club to students, share what we're all about, and sign up new members interested in exploring their career paths. Complete with handmade signs, balloons, candy, and good energy — it was a great first showing for the club.

Our team

The people behind
the club

Fellow SMC students who believe every student deserves access to real career insight — not just the ones who already know someone.

P

President

Sets the vision for the club, leads meetings, and drives partnerships with professionals and the SMC community.

VP

Vice President

Supports the President, steps in when needed, and helps coordinate events and club initiatives from start to finish.

SE

Secretary

Keeps the club organized — managing meeting notes, communications, scheduling, and internal records.

SM

Social Media & Marketing

Runs our Instagram and LinkedIn, creates content, and shapes the club's voice and brand across all platforms.

COO

Executive Director of Operations

Oversees the day-to-day running of the club, manages logistics, and makes sure everything runs smoothly behind the scenes.

OT

Outreach

Spreads the word through flyers and campus advertising, and connects with potential guest speakers for our events.

IC

ICC Delegate

Represents the club within SMC's Inter-Club Council, building relationships across the campus club network.

TR

Treasurer

Manages the club's budget, tracks expenses, and ensures we have the resources to put on great events.
